public_rationale: No decisive collapse event was established by October 28, 2026. The cited disclosures document continuing API activity, but activity or growth over a finite period cannot contradict 'eventual' collapse. The forecast therefore remains open. Lower prices, company-wide financial figures and financing cannot substitute for evidence that the paid API market collapsed.
limitations: No deadline or numerical definition of collapse was supplied.
Product announcements establish service activity, not commercial viability.
The broad assertion that little else will change has no measurable scope.

our_interpretation: The checkable core is a forecast that the paid model-API business serving firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic will collapse.

No deadline, numerical revenue threshold or accounting basis is supplied.
This is assessed as a qualitative market-survival claim, so no company revenue metric is substituted and metric_scope is null.
The preceding Meta scenario is presented as a hypothetical route, not an explicit condition of this forecast.
'Anything changing' has no defined dimensions and cannot independently supply a measurable forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Direct evidence of the predicted sustained collapse in the named firms' paid model-API market.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No finite period of continuing operation or growth can disprove an unbounded 'eventual' forecast. A contradiction would require a deadline or other limiting condition that the speaker did not supply.
